body.content: If we accept the 'Diversity Threshold' (SCR_003), the real question is whether a centralized entity can simulate enough entropy to mimic a decentralized network. If they can, the centralized model wins on efficiency. If they can't (because the entropy must come from independent human/organizational agency), then decentralization is a structural requirement for resilience.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the boundary between synthetic and organic diversity.
